_about: Assessment bench cases. Invented sessions, no client data, typed the way a BCBA types after an assessment visit. Each tests different rules in assess.js: picks only for what was done, the summary says what the Behavior Analyst did and the results say what was found, a hypothesis stays a hypothesis, nothing scored that was not.

fields.Summary Notes: ran VB-MAPP milestones levels 1 and 2 at home, 90 min. client did mands and tacts sections, mand at 6 items w full echoic, tact 8 items. listener 5 of the level 1 items. took 3 breaks, came back each time with first-then. stopped level 2 at visual perceptual, client left table. barriers: prompt dependence and impaired mand. interviewed mom for 30 min about daily routine, sleep ok, eats 6 foods, tantrums mainly at bath time. dad joined for the last 10 min and agreed bath time is the hardest part of the day. scored level 1 today, level 2 partial. next visit finish level 2 and transition assessment.

truth.answer: Prompt dependence scored 2, impaired mand scored 3.
Mom says tantrums start when the water runs, about 5 minutes, 4 nights a week.

fields.Summary Notes: FBA visit at school, observed 2 hrs in class and at recess. ABC data on hitting, 7 episodes, 5 after teacher said clean up or line up, 2 at recess when peer took ball. hits were open hand to the upper arm, no injuries. most hits followed by teacher removing the demand. got the teacher's scatterplot from the last 2 wks, most hits 9 to 10 am during worksheets. maybe escape, maybe tangible at recess, need more data before calling it. interviewed teacher 20 min, she says worse on mondays. did not do FA. next: indirect assessment w parents and 1 more observation.

truth.answer: Not decided yet, escape is the leading guess for class, tangible for recess.
Teacher thinks weekends at dad's house, not confirmed.

forbid: function of the behavior is escape

fields.Summary Notes: report writing, no client contact, about 2.5 hrs. pulled prior treatment plan and last 6 months of data from rethink. read neuropsych eval from may and the speech eval. graphed manding and elopement trends, manding up steady, elopement flat since spring. drafted 4 new goals: 2 communication, 1 social, 1 behavior reduction for elopement. wrote a baseline for each new goal from the rethink data. edited the background and history sections and updated the diagnoses list from the neuropsych. checked the auth dates against the plan, current auth ends in 6 weeks. still need to write the parent training goals before sending to clinical director.

truth.answer: Requesting help, 2 word mands, greeting peers, and elopement reduction.

fields.Summary Notes: met w both parents 1 hr to go over the reassessment. showed VB-MAPP level 1 now complete, level 2 at about half, up from level 1 only at intake. walked through 5 proposed goals. went over the 2 biggest barriers, prompt dependence and impaired mand, and why the mand goals come first. dad asked why toilet training not in goals, explained we start once sitting tolerance is 2 min, they agreed. mom wants more help with bedtime, will add a parent training goal for bedtime routine. parents signed off on goals. they asked for a copy of the graphs, sent it through the portal.

truth.answer: Goal will be a visual bedtime routine with mom, 3 steps to start.

fields.Summary Notes: BCBA reviewed FBA data from the current authorization across the reduction targets "Hugging/Jumping on People," "Aggression," "Tantrum" and "Climbing." Climbing was recorded after peer play ended in 3 of 4 instances. Aggression rose during summer camp in July and has stayed at zero since the regular school year began. BCBA updated the background, medical history and service history sections and looked at session conditions across the authorization. Behavior levels look higher in sessions with BCBA present, maybe from extra staff attention, or the BT splitting attention between the client and BCBA. Rates look lower in telehealth sessions.

truth.answer: Checked the ABC data: hugging/jumping on people was 3 instances in 3 sessions with BCBA present and 11 in 5 sessions without, so it is actually lower with BCBA.
Aggression averaged 2 per session during camp, zero since school started.
